symptom: my 'MPU6050' IMU at address 0x69 reads zero acceleration. The WHO_AM_I read returns 0xEA, not the 0x68 I expect.

files.imu.py:
from board import *
from adafruit_mpu6050 import MPU6050
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
imu = MPU6050(i2c, address=0x69)
print(imu.acceleration)

gold.diagnosis: WHO_AM_I value 0xEA is an ICM-20948 (9-axis IMU), not an MPU6050 (which returns 0x68 and reads it from register 0x75; the ICM-20948 WHO_AM_I is at register 0x70). The MPU6050 driver reads nonexistent registers on the ICM-20948, hence zero accel. Switch to the Adafruit ICM20948 driver.
